name: testNullInput
expected: Returns empty string "" because null check returns early.

name: testEmptyInput
expected: Returns empty string "" because empty length check returns early.

name: testSingleCharacterInput
expected: Returns "A" converted to uppercase because single character length check bypasses full logic.

name: testInitialKN
expected: Returns "NT" (or limited by maxCodeLen) because initial K followed by N drops the K.

name: testInitialAE
expected: Handles initial AE by dropping A and processing from E onwards.

name: testInitialWR
expected: Returns "RT" (or similar) because initial WR drops the W and starts with R.

name: testInitialWH
expected: Treats initial WH as W (converting WH -> W).

name: testInitialX
expected: Treats initial X as S by modifying first character.

name: testDuplicateCharactersExceptC
expected: Removes duplicate letters adjacent to each other except C (e.g., LL -> L).

name: testCHRules
expected: Handles CH cases correctly, yielding 'X' when followed by a vowel or 'K' when consonant.

name: testDGERules
expected: Detects DGE, DGI, DGY and encodes as 'J'.

name: testSilentGH
expected: Discards GH when terminal or before a consonant.

name: testMaxCodeLengthConstraint
expected: Truncates the resulting metaphone code to maxCodeLen (default 4).
